info.title: Sahl API
info.description:
Sahl (سهل) is a fictional GCC-style government e-services portal. V1 covers one ministry
(Ministry of Interior) and one service: the **Good Conduct Certificate**.

**Authenticate** with `POST /v1/auth/tokens`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Demo accounts (password `password`): citizen `28763404821`, reviewer `reviewer@moi.sahl.test`.

Bilingual fields are returned as `{ "ar": "...", "en": "..." }`. Money is in minor units.
All entities and data are fictional.

post.description:
Sign in with a national ID (citizens) or work email (employees). Send the returned token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Local/PoC login only. On Azure this is replaced by Entra ID.

get.description: The public service catalog. Only active services are returned.
The signed-in citizen's applications, newest first.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Only citizens can apply, and only one open application per service is allowed.

get.description: Includes the status timeline and, once approved, the certificate.
Returns 404 until the application is approved.

404.description: Not approved yet, or not your application.

get.description:
Public endpoint behind the QR code. Anyone holding the code can confirm the
certificate is genuine. Only minimal, masked personal data is returned.

429.description: More than 30 checks per minute from this IP.

get.description:
Only applications belonging to the employee’s own ministry. Oldest first, so the
queue is worked in order.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Defaults to all.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

get.description: Includes the applicant's details for review.

post.description: Approves the application and issues its certificate. Returns 409 if it was already decided.

409.description: The application was already approved or rejected.

post.description: The reason is shown to the applicant. Returns 409 if it was already decided.

409.description: The application was already approved or rejected.

sla.description: Service level: working days allowed, working days waited so far (Friday and Saturday excluded), and whether it is late.

actor.description: Who acted. Reviewer identities are never exposed, only "applicant" or "ministry".

note.description: Optional internal note, visible to the applicant.

verification_url.description: Public web page a third party (e.g. an employer) opens to check the certificate. Encoded in the QR code. Apps can call `GET /certificates/verify/{code}` instead.

holder_national_id_masked.description: Only the last 4 digits are shown, e.g. "*******4821".

device_name.description: A label for the token, e.g. "postman" or "iphone".

reason.description: Why the application was rejected. Shown to the applicant.

service.description: Slug of the service to apply for.

addressed_to.description: Who the certificate is addressed to. Leave empty for "To whom it may concern".

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
